text:
## Training & Competency  
**Staff Required Training:**
- Document authentication (spotting fakes, security features)
- Customer communication (explaining KYC requirements clearly)
- System data entry (accurate recording)
- Compliance procedures (what to escalate)  
**Certification:**
- Pass knowledge assessment
- Practical observation (verified by manager on 5+ customers)
- Annual refresher training

raw_entities.name: Staff Training and Competency Process
raw_entities.description: The end-to-end procedure for ensuring staff are trained and certified in document authentication, customer communication, data entry, and compliance procedures. It includes a knowledge assessment and practical observation.

raw_entities.name: Document Authentication Training
raw_entities.description: Training staff on how to identify counterfeit documents and recognise legitimate security features.

raw_entities.name: Customer Communication Training
raw_entities.description: Instruction on how to clearly explain the bank's Know Your Customer (KYC) requirements to customers.

raw_entities.name: System Data Entry Training
raw_entities.description: Training to ensure accurate recording of customer information into the bank's systems.

raw_entities.name: Compliance Procedures Training
raw_entities.description: Training regarding the specific compliance rules and the criteria for when a matter must be escalated.

raw_entities.name: Knowledge Assessment
raw_entities.description: A formal test that staff must pass as part of their certification process.

raw_entities.name: Practical Observation Assessment
raw_entities.description: A practical evaluation where a manager observes the staff member processing at least 5 customers to verify competency.
context: Practical observation (verified by manager on 5+ customers)

raw_entities.name: Annual Refresher Training
raw_entities.description: Mandatory yearly training to maintain staff competency and updated knowledge of procedures.

raw_entities.name: Staff Member
raw_entities.description: The personnel undergoing training and certification in operational and compliance procedures.

raw_entities.name: Manager
raw_entities.description: The individual responsible for verifying a staff member's competency through practical observation of customer interactions.

raw_entities.name: Certification Approval Gate
raw_entities.description: A decision point where staff must pass both the knowledge assessment and the practical observation to be certified.
context: Practical observation (verified by manager on 5+ customers)
